locked_candidate.statement: For every real unit-diagonal SPD A, with mu=lambda_min(A) and L=ceil(16/mu), (L_A^*)^L(A) <= A/2.
positive_evidence: An analytic exact all-n proof closes the route-card family A_n=(1/n)I+(1-1/n)11^T.
An analytic exact all-epsilon proof closes the noncommuting symmetry-breaking family A_eps=eps I+(1-eps)Gram(e1,e2,(3e1+4e2)/5).
An analytic exact all-epsilon proof closes the unequal rank-three star family generated by e1,e2,e3,(36e1+24e2+23e3)/49.
An analytic exact all-epsilon proof closes the warm edge on the signed rank-two tight frame generated by (1,0),(0,1),(3,4)/5,(4,-3)/5.
An exact sparse-polynomial proof closes the formerly timed-out generic unequal signed rank-two family for every 0<eps<1.
An exact all-epsilon proof closes a rank-four sign-frustrated rational five-cycle after averaging all 120 permutations.

The phase-2 seeded float64 all-permutation scout found no violation among 1792 matrices in dimensions 3 through 6; two continuation scouts through dimension 7 also found no candidate. All numerical null results remain E1.
locked_candidate.open_objection: No dimension-uniform argument controls the order-unit orbit for an arbitrary unit-diagonal SPD matrix.

first_bad_edge.edge: self-adjoint full-Sym covariance control to dimension-free order-unit decay
first_bad_edge.exact_failed_step: The direct Hilbert-Schmidt transfer is y^T C^k(I)y <= sqrt(n) rho(C)^k ||y||^2; its sqrt(n) factor cannot yield the locked O(1/mu)-epoch block uniformly in n.
first_bad_edge.scope: This is a proof-route barrier, not a counterexample to the locked block lemma or C050.

repair_candidate.statement: With H_j=(L_A^*)^j(A), H_2 <= (1-mu)H_1 for every real unit-diagonal SPD A.
repair_candidate.equivalent_statement: In energy coordinates, with D=I-C(I), C(D) >= mu C(I).
repair_candidate.target_transfer: Positivity gives H_L <= (1-mu)^(L-1)A <= exp(-15)A for L=ceil(16/mu), so the repair would prove the locked lemma and hence C050.
finite_and_slice_evidence: Exact symbolic proof for every 2x2 unit-diagonal SPD matrix.
Exact analytic proof on both all-parameter falsifier families, because each already has the stronger H_1 <= (1-mu)A form.
Exact verification on one unequal signed rank-two rational n=4 family member with mu=7/10.
Exact all-epsilon proof on the signed rank-two tight-frame family with eigenvalues eps,eps,2-eps,2-eps.
Exact all-epsilon proof on a generic unequal signed rank-two boundary via positive Bernstein coefficients and an exact eps=7/10 digest cross-check.
Exact all-epsilon proof on a rank-four sign-frustrated five-cycle via positive Bernstein coefficients through determinant degree 100.

No float64 violation in the 1792-matrix phase-2 scout, the 14-configuration continuation attack, or the 252-matrix subset-DP scout through n=12; the newest minimum diagnostic effective coefficient is 1.0256742913029933.
open_objections: No proof is known outside the exact slices.
A positive two-epoch result may still be another overstrong covariance certificate even though it is weaker than fixed-A one-epoch contraction.
The numerical margin becomes small near A=I, so floating-point null tests there are not decisive.

reachable_cone_reformulation.exact_equivalence: C(D)>=mu C(I) if and only if D-mu I belongs to the trace-polar cone K_1(A)^*, because <yy^T,C(D-mu I)>=<C(yy^T),D-mu I>.
reachable_cone_reformulation.forbidden_shortcut: Replacing K_1(A)^* by the full PSD dual would require D>=mu I, the unit-coefficient fixed-A one-epoch certificate. It is stronger and is not assumed.
reachable_cone_reformulation.open_objection: No general polar-cone description or separation bound is proved.

exact_failed_attempt.scope: This refutes only the 4/3 repair coefficient. The unit coefficient survives this exact matrix and the locked 16/mu lemma is not affected.

failed_symbolic_attempt.outcome: Direct symbolic H_2/principal-minor expansion timed out before a sign certificate was produced.
failed_symbolic_attempt.scope: This was expression swell, not a counterexample.
failed_symbolic_attempt.resolution: Sparse Fraction polynomial convolution plus exact Bernstein coefficients proves H_2<(1-eps)H_1 for every 0<eps<1 on this family.

new_higher_rank_attack.outcome: All five exact Bernstein/Sylvester certificates pass after averaging all 120 permutations; the cycle edge-sign product is negative.
new_higher_rank_attack.scope: Route-local analytic slice only; no hostile audit and no generalization to arbitrary A.

higher_dimensional_subset_scout.scope: The exact subset recurrence removes factorial enumeration, but the arithmetic and finite null search remain numerical.

reachable_vs_full_psd_numerical_separato.outcome: The stronger full-PSD shortcut numerically fails while the reachable warm inequality survives on the same matrix.
reachable_vs_full_psd_numerical_separato.scope: This is not exact or interval-certified and does not refute the warm inequality, the locked block lemma, C051 with a smaller constant, or C050.

reopen_or_close_conditions: An exact rational matrix with a negative principal minor of (1-mu)H_1-H_2 would close the two-epoch repair and trigger a longer-chain branch.
A quantified proof of C(D)>=mu C(I), with fresh-permutation and Loewner semantics explicit, would advance the locked route to a proof candidate, still requiring a different-run hostile audit.
A direct proof of sum_{j=0}^{L-1} C^j(D)>=I/2 could bypass the two-epoch repair while remaining on the locked covariance block-power representation.
